lines.text: On the first day of the seventh month, Ezra read the Law aloud to the people from daybreak until noon.
Ezra stood on a high wooden platform, and when he opened the book, all the people sat down.
The Levites explained the Law to the people so that they could understand what was being read.
The people wept, so Nehemiah told them to eat, drink and send out portions, because the joy of the LORD is their strength.
The people made booths from branches, and they had not celebrated like this since the days of King David.
